text: 🎬 Universal is sitting on the Elon Musk doc it paid millions for Alex Gibney , who took on Scientology in 'Going Clear' , finished a four-hour Musk portrait. Bleecker Street releases it in the US on October 16. Universal bought international rights in 2023 and is now going cold. Let's call it what it is. Catch-and-kill logic without the clean NDA paperwork. The film exists, it has Oscar buzz, and Universal just doesn't want the phone calls that come with releasing it abroad. Gibney has always aimed at targets who push back hard. A studio hesitating to distribute his work tells you more about the subject than any trailer could. ✈️ Add to watchlist
